steps.executor_prompt: Open the exact target described by Default Browser and go to github.com/login. If Default Browser and go to github.com/login requests Default Browser, Browser, navigation to a URL, or contains a URL, leave any system default-browser settings screen, open DuckDuckGo, and navigate to that exact URL; use another installed browser only if DuckDuckGo is unavailable. Verify the visible domain belongs to the target before entering {user} and {password} where required, then submit the sign-in form. If multiple verification methods are offered, choose the method matching Google Voice; for an SMS inbox such as Google Voice, choose SMS or phone rather than email. Confirm the masked destination and delivery channel match that source, using Try another way if necessary, then request the code. Stop only when the verified target confirms the code was sent through the correct channel and displays an OTP input.
steps.auditor_prompt: AUDIT ONLY. Do not tap, type, swipe, or change anything on screen. Inspect the CURRENT screen state and decide whether this task was actually completed successfully: OTP has been requested/sent OR an OTP input field is visible on screen. Do not rely on memory or on what an earlier agent claimed -- judge only from what is visible right now. If you cannot clearly confirm success, treat it as not passed. Report your verdict as structured output.

steps.executor_prompt: Keep the target session open and retrieve the current OTP from its delivery source. When the login flow selected SMS for Google Voice, open Google Voice immediately even if the source name is not repeated; use Messages only when ordinary carrier SMS is explicitly indicated. Unlock if prompted, refresh the inbox, and open the newest message received after the request that identifies the target service or domain. Ignore older or unrelated codes and report only the current OTP. If no matching message appears, refresh once more before reporting that no code was found.

Return to the existing DuckDuckGo tab containing the OTP challenge for Default Browser and go to github.com/login; do not open another browser, inspect system default-browser settings, or replace the active session. Use the reported OTP only if it is exactly six digits and came from a new message clearly matching the target. If no valid OTP was reported, do not use any unrelated or older code: on the target challenge choose Try another way, select an SMS or phone delivery option associated with the account, request a fresh code, open Google Voice, refresh, and read only the newest target-matching message that arrived after the request. Return to the same DuckDuckGo tab, verify the target domain and challenge, enter the code, submit it, and wait for account-specific authenticated content or an explicit login-success confirmation. If no SMS option or matching new message is available, report failure.
